comparison.objective: Lay a cover bar over a cable at the marked walkway crossing.
comparison.physical_skill: Rigid-object placement and planar/angular alignment over a cable.
comparison.success_condition: Cover must rest flat, within 15° of cable direction and 1.9 cm of its centerline; full credit additionally requires 1.5 cm cable and 2 cm walkway-depth tolerances.
comparison.reason: This is tolerance-based cover placement; it lacks bimanual striking, contact-loaded fracture, protected retained hardware, and loose-fragment collection.
